setup_registry: create a new fairseq registry with setup_registry to manage component registration and building
register_x: register a new class with the fairseq registry using the register_x decorator
build_x: build a fairseq component instance from a DictConfig, string name, or argparse Namespace
merge_with_parent: merge a child dataclass config with its parent using merge_with_parent from fairseq dataclass utils
REGISTRIES: inspect the global REGISTRIES dictionary to list all registered fairseq registries and their dataclass registries
